summary: Invesco Mortgage Capital Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 7.01 and 8.01) on May 14, 2026, disclosing a press release with a monthly common stock dividend of $0.12 per share for May 2026 and preliminary financial data as of April 30, 2026, including book value, portfolio, liquidity, and leverage updates. The registrant is the issuer of the dividend, which is a routine capital return event, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special situation is indicated.
